name: Loon Lake copper mine
note: No longer open to the public, per the guide that used to list it. Old reports and Mindat records still point here: don't go without the owner's OK.

name: Diatomaceous Earth mine (Saddle Mountains opal wood)
note: No longer open to the public, per the guide that used to list it. The famous opalized wood here is on a working mine claim.

name: Mica Mountain
note: Private land, per the guide that used to list it. Ask the owner first.

name: Solo Creek quartz dig
note: USFS temporarily closed the 5-acre quartz dig in Oct 2023 (hazard trees and open holes). Check with the Colville National Forest before going.

name: Rock N Tomahawk Ranch
note: Fee-dig ranch for Ellensburg blue agate, reported closed permanently to the public (one Reddit report, 2025, unverified). Call before going; everything around it is private.

name: Emerald Creek Garnet Area
note: USFS fee site CLOSED for the rest of 2026: the excavated garnet supply ran out. Huckleberry Garnet Mine nearby is the private alternative.
